title: Reprocessing and rework policy
question: When a processing attempt fails, is rejected in review or is cancelled, what happens next? Who may start a new attempt, how many automatic retries are allowed, and which attempt's output becomes the one customers see?
context: Failed and rejected runs are terminal today (PROC-REQ-020). Scheduled VM jobs that fail to start get a replacement run, manual jobs don't (PROC-REQ-023). Operators can split a run into a new child run for review (PROC-REQ-024). Cancelling only changes the local record (PROC-REQ-022). No rule says which attempt is authoritative.
